declarations.name: AuiDurationPicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI DurationPicker: `<aui-duration-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Inclusive lower bound for validation and stepping (non-negative). Stepping stops at zero when unset. Must not exceed max.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Inclusive upper bound for validation and stepping (non-negative); also sets the digits and aria-valuemax of the largest segment.

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Increment of the smallest segment and the valid-value grid from zero. Positive and a whole number of the smallest unit.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name for the hidden input (ISO 8601 duration, for example PT1H30M).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: An empty entry is invalid; segments are required and the required indicator is shown.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted; not editable, and stepping, Home/End, and separators are ignored.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation after built-in checks; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Unit segments, largest first, as a contiguous non-empty run of 'days' | 'hours' | 'minutes' | 'seconds'.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Segment names, unit text and its position, aria-valuetext, durations in messages, and messages.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Direction of the group; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight follow it.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the value or its validity error (typing, stepping, Home/End, or a separator).

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 duration in hours, minutes, and seconds (PT1H30M), or null when empty or invalid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state (no events).

accessibility.pattern: Labelled group of WAI-ARIA APG Spinbutton segments (one text input per unit) with no popup; each segment exposes its unit value and a localized value text.

limitations: Negative durations are not supported; value, min, and max must be non-negative.
Calendar durations (years, months, weeks) are not supported; a day is always 24 hours.
The value and step must be whole numbers of the smallest unit in fields; milliseconds cannot be entered.
Without max, the largest segment is limited by its digits (999 days, 999 hours, 9,999 minutes, or 99,999 seconds).
Only ASCII digits are accepted in segments; locale digits (for example Arabic-Indic) are not parsed.
No popup or preset list; values are typed or stepped.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
